title: SitPlugin By ORJ
description: A lightweight plugin that lets players sit anywhere in the world using a simple command or interaction. Great for roleplay and immersion, with easy setup and smooth performance.
body:
The Sit plugin adds a simple yet immersive feature to your Minecraft server: the ability for players to sit anywhere in the world. With just a quick command or an easy interaction, players can sit on stairs, slabs, and even flat blocks, making your server feel more alive and roleplay-friendly.

This plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient, ensuring it has minimal impact on server performance while still delivering a smooth and polished experience. It’s perfect for roleplay servers, survival worlds, hubs, or any community looking to add more realism and interaction.

Key Features:

Sit anywhere using a simple command or interaction system
Works on stairs, slabs, and configurable blocks
Lightweight and optimized for performance
Easy installation with no complex setup required
Fully configurable to fit your server’s needs
Enhances immersion and roleplay experience

Whether you’re building a realistic city, a cozy survival world, or a roleplay server, Sit helps bring your environment to life by letting players naturally interact with the world in a new way.

Simple, clean, and effective — Sit is the perfect small feature that makes a big difference in player experience.

by ORJ
